About Us – Exotic Metals LLP
At 
Exotic Metals LLP
, we take pride in being one of India's leading 
stockists, 
 exporters, and 
 distributors of exotic and high-performance metals
. Established under the visionary 
 leadership of
 Mr Kalpesh Doshi
, the company has built a strong reputation for 
 reliability, 
 precision, and service excellence across global markets.
With a robust infrastructure that includes 
warehouses in Navi Mumbai 
and a 
manufacturing 
 facility in Pawane, Navi Mumbai – 400710
, we are equipped to meet the growing 
 demands of 
 diverse industries such as 
aerospace, defence, oil & gas, pharmaceuticals, research 
 sectors 
 and more
. 
Our product portfolio features a wide range of materials, including 
Titanium, Nickel 
 Alloys, 
 Zirconium, Duplex & Super Duplex Stainless Steel, and other rare alloys
, available 
 in 
 multiple forms like 
bars, pipes, sheets, fittings, fasteners, and custom fabricated 
 components.
What sets us apart is our commitment to 
quality, innovation, and timely delivery.
 Each 
 product is sourced and manufactured with precision to meet international standards and 
 client-specific requirements.
At Exotic Metals LLP, we believe in forging long-term partnerships through trust, 
 transparency, and consistent performance — making us a trusted name in India's metal 
 industry and a preferred partner for clients worldwide.
Top Quality Manufacturer
OUR VISION
At Exotic Metals LLP, we envision a future where our products form the backbone of 
 next-generation engineering, innovation, and industrial excellence.Our vision is to be 
 recognized as a 
global leader in exotic metals 
— setting 
 benchmarks in quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. 
 We aim to:
Expand our global footprint by delivering world-class materials to 
 every primary industrial market.
Invest in QUICKEST DELIVERY and infrastructure to ensure 
sustainability and precision.
Foster a culture of 
continuous improvement,
 where 
 integrity, expertise, and customer focus drive every decision.
Our Commitment
At Exotic Metals LLP, integrity, quality, and customer satisfaction are at the core of 
 everything we do. We guarantee product excellence, transparency, and timely delivery, while 
 also embracing environmental responsibility and a culture of continuous improvement. 
We don't just supply materials — we enable innovation, fuel growth, and help industries 
 shape the future.
OUR MISSION
At 
Exotic Metals LLP
, our mission is to deliver 
high-quality exotic metals and 
 alloys
 that empower industries to innovate, perform, and excel. 
 We are committed to:
Providing a comprehensive range of
 premium-grade materials
 that meet global 
 standards. 
Building long-term partnerships through 
trust, transparency, 
 and reliability.
Our mission is to be the 
preferred partner 
for clients who 
 seek excellence in 
 materials, 
 precision in service, and innovation in every order. 
 Founder & Visionary 
Mr Kalpesh Doshi
 is the 
Founder and Owner of Exotic Metals LLP
. With years of 
 experience in 
 the metal industry, he has successfully built one of India's most trusted names in exotic 
 alloys. He is also the Founder of
 Aries Alloys,
 a leading supplier of titanium raw 
 materials.
 Under his leadership, Exotic Metals LLP has expanded into international markets, earning 
 recognition for its commitment to excellence, export capability, and customer-first 
 approach.
Our History
Exotic Metals LLP was established with a vision to redefine 
 India's presence in the global market for 
exotic and high-performance 
 metals
. Over the years, we have grown from a 
 specialized stockist in Mumbai to a reputed 
manufacturer, exporter, and 
 distributor
 with a strong footprint across 
 multiple industries, including 
aerospace, defence, oil & gas, 
 pharmaceuticals, research, and heavy engineering
.
With our 
warehouses strategically located in 
 Navi Mumbai
 and our 
manufacturing facility in Pawane, Navi Mumbai – 400710
, we ensure efficient operations and timely deliveries for 
 clients across India and abroad. Our infrastructure is equipped with advanced machining, 
 fabrication, and testing equipment that allows us to meet the most demanding 
 specifications.
We specialize in a comprehensive product range that 
 includes:
Round Bar, Hexagon 
 Bar, Forged Bar, Square Bar, Hollow Bar, Rectangular Pipe, Square Pipe, ERW Pipe, 
 Seamless Pipe, Capillary, Sheet, Plate, Coil, Strip, Wire, Angle / Channel, Wire Mesh, 
 Flanges, Forged Fittings, Pipe Fittings, Fasteners, Gaskets, Circles, and Custom 
 Fabricated Products.
Each of these products reflects our commitment to 
quality, precision, and consistency
, 
 making Exotic Metals LLP a preferred partner for industries that rely on superior 
 materials and dependable service. Our continuous growth and global recognition are built 
 on the pillars of innovation, integrity, and long-term partnerships.
Our Core Strengths
 QUALITY ASSURANCE
Our strict quality control ensures 
 every product meets industry 
 standards and exceeds expectations.
CUSTOMIZATION
We desten fasteners to your exact 
 specifications for a perfect fit and top
 performance.
RELIABLE DELIVERY
Our efficient supply chain 
 guarantees timely delivery to meet 
 your 
deadlines.
PRODUCT RANGE
We offer sheets, fasteners, pipes, 
 and much more to meet all
 your 
 needs.
